title: Rincon Oceanview Villa 16 People with Two Pools

images.caption: Ladder Ball, Corn Hole, SpikeBall, Volleyball, Frisbee Golf.

description: This Oceanview Villa and Converted School Bus with a total of 4 bathrooms with two pools is located 3 minutes to the beach and close to downtown Rincon and Aguada. A perfect place for families or friends visiting the island. The house itself is on two levels, the main level with 3 bedrooms and 2 baths and a separate apartment with a 3rd full bath accessible via the spacious terrace. Additionally the Converted School bus and pool are only a 15 second walk and part of the gated property.The spaceEnjoy this large property located in Aguada and bordering Rincon, with multiple spaces to relax. You are 8-10 minutes to both downtown Rincon and Aguada and only 3 minutes to the beach. You can stay in the air conditioned house and enjoy the ocean breeze and ocean view, you can relax on the terrace by the pool or swim in the main pool. We also have another dipping pool at the converted and fully air conditioned school bus. The bus has its own small outdoor kitchenette, OUTDOOR RUSTIC open air bathroom and BBQ as well as a coffee maker. We offer lots of parking with 6 spots available in front of the house and one by the converted bus. The property has two refrigerators, a large fridge on the main level and a small fridge in the converted school bus. You will never run out of space for your cold drinks.We also have lots of other activities available on our property. We offer:- Volleyball- Frisbee Golf- Corn Hole- Spike Ball- and Ladder TossThe area where all this is setup is next to a small Creek and surrounded by Bamboo and Palm trees for nice shaded spots to sit. This will keep adults and children busy during your stay.The kitchen on the main level is well equipped:A full gas stove, large fridge, plates and silverware for 18 people, microwave, large blender, coffee maker and the outdoor gas BBQ with a side stove for your outside cooking needs.The Converted School Bus offers:Another small dipping pool, a small exterior kitchenette area with dishes and silverware, an outdoor gas BBQ and outdoor shower with hot water and an outdoor toilet. The only thing is that the school bus does not have internet as the signal does not reach that area well but your phone and you phones hotspot will work well.Please for reference review all the images so you see what we have available for you on our property.We have fiberoptic wifi at the house (but not at the bus). We do not offer access to laundry. We provide one bath towel per person. We do not provide beach towels or other beach accessories such as beach chairs, umbrellas etc. The main house a smart TV. Access your own entertainment accounts on the TV please as we do not provide a dedicated Netflix, HULU or other account for the house. The converted school bus does not have TV. Puerto Rico can occasionally experience power and water outages. They are beyond our control. We provide a backup generator that can run from 6 pm to 7 am and will need to be turned off during the day. We also provide backup water (cool only-not heated) - we have a 400 gallon cistern that gravity feeds the house. The pressure will be significantly lower but you will have water in the house. Please, only book if you are willing to accept the above stated for the rare power and water outages that we are experiencing. Enjoy your stayGuest accessWill be provided before arrival

description: 2 bedroom, 3 bathroom pristine townhouse located in Puntas beach road, steps away from renowned beaches, bars and restaurants. The 1st floor has two bedrooms and one full bathroom. The 2nd floor is an open area concept with a fully equipped kitchen, living room with TV, dinning area, a half bathroom, and a small breakfast nook balcony. The 3rd floor features an al fresco terrace with astonishing ocean views, a hammock, a table for 4, 2 lounge chairs and a half a bathroom.The spaceBeautiful 3 floors Mediterranean style Villa with 1,500 sq feet of comfort, with all the amenities and furnishings needed for a relaxing vacation getaway for a family of 4, 2 couples or 4 friends. It is located in a secure gated community with a nice swimming pool, air-conditioned clubhouse and out door showers. The unit is short walk to renowned beaches, awesome bars, nightlife and restaurants; yet far away enough were all the noise won’t bother you. The first floor has 2 air-conditioned bedrooms, one full bath and a laundry with a washer and dryer. The Master bedroom has a plush full size bed, nightstands and lamps, also has a big closet where you can store luggage and clothing. Bedroom #2 has 2 twin beds, nightstand, and an ample closet for luggage and clothing.The second floor has a fully equipped kitchen with: pot, pans, skillet, oven, microwave oven, toaster, coffee maker, cooking utensils, and silverware. There is a dinning table that sits 4, a comfy sofa with a TV and a ceiling fan. There is also a half bath and a balcony to enjoy your breakfast and coffee in the morning. The Third floor is an al fresco terrace with an amazing ocean view, great spot to enjoy Rincon’s sunsets and relax in the evenings. There is a table that sits 4, 2 lounge chairs, 2 beach chairs, hammock, small charcoal BBQ and a half a bathroom.The Unit has three parking spots assigned to it, there is a emergency generator that powers the whole complex and a water cistern for water in case of an emergency.

description: Escape to a rustic retreat at Casita Indio Taíno, surrounded by jungle near Rincón’s beaches. Expect birds, coquí frogs, and insects as part of the experience. Enjoy a private outdoor bathroom, open-air tub, and outdoor kitchen. The bathroom is outdoors but private, and neither the tub nor shower has hot water, making it a refreshing tropical stay. Relax on the deck, take in the jungle, and enjoy this tranquil off-the-grid haven.The spaceImmerse yourself in the serene beauty of the jungle in our rustic cabin, surrounded by lush trees and wildlife. Relax on the deck, cook meals in the outdoor kitchen, or unwind in the open-air tub decorated with wood and flowers. Expect birds, coquí frogs, and insects as part of the natural experience. The cabin offers the essentials for a peaceful stay and is conveniently close to Rincón’s town center. Explore the area with rented bicycles or visit the beach just minutes away. With its secluded setting yet easy access to town, our cabin is a perfect retreat for nature lovers, couples, or anyone seeking a calm escape.Guest accessGuests have full use of the cabin’s living space, outdoor kitchen, private outdoor bathroom, and deck. The outdoor tub, surrounded by greenery, offers a refreshing way to unwind in nature. Expect a rustic stay where you may see insects, hear birds, and enjoy the sounds of the jungle. All spaces are private and designed to provide a comfortable yet natural escape close to Rincón.Other things to noteOur cabin is set in a lush jungle environment, so you will hear coquí frogs, owls, and crickets at night, and insects may be present as part of the natural setting, though we keep the space clean and tidy. The bathroom has a private entrance separate from the main cabin for added privacy, and the shower does not have hot water, offering a refreshing tropical experience.
